subject: U-442 repair: all five stickers closed, no production change

No real defect was found — untouched verify.py already behaves correctly in both mutant dimensions, so these were adequacy gaps and nothing in runtime/scripts/ changed; head is 85a1e797, manifest head_sha 47b3f1f2 with all four receipts bound to tree 02ed5304, suite 1736 OK, validate exit 0, floor-guard clean (6 waived), control GREEN clean / RED (26 assertion failures) reverted to base, worktree clean.
